blocks.text: Architectural facade design for a barbershop, Kyiv, Ukraine

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) developed an architectural solution for the renovation of a barbershop facade in Kyiv, Ukraine. The project called for a skillful balance of contemporary design, a recognizable brand identity, and the architectural character of the surrounding urban environment.

The main goal was to transform the existing facade and create a striking look for the commercial property — one that attracts attention, reinforces the brand’s positioning, and interacts harmoniously with the surrounding architecture.
Barbershop facade design The architectural concept combines modern finishing materials, carefully selected color solutions, decorative elements, and exterior lighting.
Particular attention was paid to the entrance area, the proportions of the facade, visual accents, and details that emphasize the barbershop’s individuality and make it more visible from the street.
The result is a contemporary commercial facade design that creates a recognizable image for the business and matches the atmosphere of a premium men’s space.
Architecture for a commercial brand For a commercial property, the facade is an important part of the brand’s visual presentation and the customer’s first impression.
— a visual connection with the barbershop’s brand identity;
— a functional, clearly marked entrance area;
— integration of the property into the surrounding urban environment.
This approach makes it possible to create an expressive commercial facade that serves architectural, functional, and image-building purposes at the same time.
3D visualization of the barbershop facade Photorealistic 3D visualizations of the facade were created to clearly present the architectural concept.
The visualizations show the proposed finishing materials, color solutions, architectural details, decorative lighting, the entrance area, and the overall appearance of the renovated building.
3D visualization makes it possible to evaluate the architectural solution before implementation and see how the renovated barbershop facade will look within its urban surroundings.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) — architectural design, commercial facade design, renovation solutions, and photorealistic 3D visualization.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN — we create architecture that works for your brand.
